yaml.description: Join the DahShu IDSWG, membership is open and free.

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}

Join the IDSWG

Membership is open and free. Observe, contribute, lead, or start something new, at your own pace.

Ways to Participate Open Positions Contact the Team Mailing List
``` ::: {.content-section} ```{=html}

Observe

Join the mailing list, attend KOL webinars, and follow sub-team activities with no commitment required.

Contribute

Co-author papers, review manuscripts, present at webinars, or bring expertise to a specific project.

Lead

Take on a sub-team leadership role. The Leadership Team provides mentorship and support for new leads.

Start Something New

Prepare a one-page concept and meet with the leadership team to discuss scope, fit, and support for a new sub-team.

``` ## Open Positions & Active Recruitment {#recruiting} - **Master Protocol Regulatory Sub-team**, Volunteers for the 2020–2025 Systematic Literature Review update (full-text review, data extraction). Contact Peter Mesenbrink or Julia Niewczas. - **Patient Engagement Sub-team**, Seeking a new sub-team leader to champion the integration of patient perspectives into innovative trial design. Open to patient advocates, clinical researchers, and methodologists with a patient-centered focus. Contact Mercedeh Ghadessi. - **Concept, Methodology and Framework Sub-team (MPWG)**, Undergoing a reboot under Bryan McComb and Courtney Henry. New members welcome. Contact either directly. - **Patient advocates and patient organizations**, The IDSWG specifically welcomes patient advocates as full members. If your organization works in rare diseases or another area where the group is active, we'd like to hear from you. ## Contact the Leadership Team {#contact} ```{=html}
Role Name Organization Contact
Chair Robert A. Beckman, M.D. Georgetown University Email Robert Beckman
Vice Chair & Leader of Community Mercedeh Ghadessi, Ph.D. Bayer Email Mercedeh Ghadessi
Vice Chair & Leader of External Collaborations Alex Sverdlov, Ph.D. Novartis Email Alex Sverdlov
Co-Leader of Community Courtney Henry, Ph.D. GSK Email Courtney Henry
Co-Leader of External Collaborations (Non-EU) Bryan McComb, Ph.D. Pfizer Email Bryan McComb
Co-Leader of External Collaborations (EU) Johannes Krisam, Ph.D. Boehringer Ingelheim Email Johannes Krisam
``` ```{=html}

Stay Connected

Subscribe to the DahShu community for notifications about upcoming IDSWG events, webinars, publications, and working group opportunities.

Get Involved View Upcoming Events
``` ## Get Involved {#newsletter} Fill out the form below to express your interest in the IDSWG and be added to communications about upcoming events, publications, and working group opportunities. ```{=html}

Click below to open the DahShu subscription page, enter your email and select IDSWG updates.

  Get Involved

Your information is held by DahShu and is not shared with third parties.

Page last reviewed:

``` :::
